svg.title: The federal Notice to Cosigner, excerpted, with three sentences marked
svg.desc: An excerpt of the Notice to Cosigner required by federal rule (16 CFR 444.3): You are being asked to guarantee this debt. Think carefully before you do. Marked 1: If the borrower doesn't pay the debt, you will have to. Be sure you can afford to pay if you have to, and that you want to accept this responsibility. Marked 2: You may have to pay up to the full amount of the debt if the borrower does not pay. You may also have to pay late fees or collection costs, which increase this amount. Marked 3: The creditor can collect this debt from you without first trying to collect from the borrower. If this debt is ever in default, that fact may become a part of your credit record. Lenders such as auto dealers and finance companies must hand this to a co-signer as a separate page.
svg.text: REQUIRED BY FEDERAL RULE · EXCERPT
Notice to Cosigner
You are being asked to guarantee this
debt. Think carefully before you do.
If the borrower doesn't pay the debt, you
will have to.
Be sure you can afford to pay if you have
to, and that you want to accept this
responsibility.
You may have to pay up to the full amount
of the debt if the borrower does not pay.
You may also have to pay late fees or
collection costs, which increase this
amount.
The creditor can collect this debt from
you without first trying to collect from
the borrower.
If this debt is ever in default, that fact
may become a part of your credit record.
Lenders such as auto dealers and finance companies must
hand this to a co-signer as a separate page.
